job.title: Employment Mentor
job.description:
About MobReady: 
MobReady is an Aboriginal owned & operated organisation with a purpose to create culturally safe pathways for our people into employment. Established in 2021 as part of the Indigeco group, MobReady now has multiple programs and services being delivered across NSW, ACT & QLD.
 
With exciting growth across the business, we have some deadly opportunities to join our team and help lead the impact!
 
We currently offer:
  • Traineeships & Apprenticeships
  • Pre-Employment Programs
  • Mentoring
  • The RISE Project - Rebuilding your Identity and Strength for Employment
  • REAL - Reconnection, Employment and Learning
  • Journey to Success - School programs
The Role: 
We are actively looking for an Employment mentor to join our REAL team to support First Nations people exiting incarceration in Western Sydney. You'll provide culturally safe support upto 6-months pre-release and continue supporting 12-months post-release with a strong focus on reconnection to community, culture and employment. 
 
This is a full-time contract until June 30, 2030, and will be based out of our Penrith office Monday to Friday. 
 
Main Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Workshop & program facilitation
  • Cultural activities
  • Administrations tasks
  • Compliance management
  • Community engagement
  • Mentoring of First Nations people exiting incarceration
  • Case management
  • Employer engagement
  • Employment placement 
  • Service referrals & advocacy
  • Stakeholder engagement
 
The above list is not exhaustive, and the role may change to meet the overall objectives of the company.
 
Knowledge & Experience:
  • Relevant experience in similar programs or industry.
  • Connection to the First Nations community and culture
  • Knowledge and understanding of the Justice system and it's impact on First Nations communities.
Skills & Competencies:
  • Customer service focused: committed to providing exceptional customer service across all channels - written, phone and face to face.
  • Communication: the ability to communicate clearly and concisely, varying communication style depending upon the audience.
  • Attention to detail: excellent attention to detail and written skills when communicating with others, both internally and externally.
  • Commerciality: ability to apply knowledge in a practical, commercial manner.
  • Teamwork: willingness to assist and support others as required and get on with team members.
  • Time management/organisation: accomplish objectives effectively within time frame given, and carry out administrative duties within portfolio in an efficient and timely manner.
Personal Attributes:
  • Professional approach.
  • Ability to work under pressure.
  • Organisational and time management skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Confident manner.
  • Positive approach to change.
  • Strong administrative skills
  • Ability to manage conflict
Criteria:
  • Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander
  • A valid/current Australian Driver's License is required to complete the roles and responsibilities of this position.
  • A clear criminal history is required to complete the roles and responsibilities of this position.
  • Connection to community & culture

Trainee Administration Officer

Employment Type: Full-Time Traineeship (12 Months)
Course - Certificate III Business Administration
 
Are you looking to kick-start your career in administration and business operations?

MobReady is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Trainee Administration Officer to join our host employer's team and gain hands-on experience across multiple areas of their organisation.
 
This is an exciting opportunity to develop practical workplace skills, complete a recognised qualification, and gain exposure to a variety of business functions while working alongside experienced professionals.

As a Trainee Administration Officer, you will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operations of the business while learning about the broader business.

You will have the opportunity to work across several departments, gaining valuable experience in:
  • Finance

    • Vender Management
    • Document and records management
    • Meeting coordination and event support
    • General office administration
  • Contracting
    • Assisting with contract administration processes

    • Learning about procurement and governance requirements
This unique rotational experience will provide a comprehensive understanding of how different teams work together to support the business' objectives.

The Cotton Research and Development Corporation (CRDC) is responsible for investing in research, development and extension activities that improve the productivity, profitability and sustainability of the Australian cotton industry.
We work closely with growers, researchers, industry partners and government stakeholders to deliver outcomes that benefit the industry and regional communities.
